# Ritro

> Ritro is a free, open source personal archive for links. Save anything with a URL, AI tags it a few seconds later, and Ritro brings saves back through a daily digest email and a "Surprise me" button. Built by one person, Minit Jain. Licensed AGPL-3.0.

Ritro is a web app at https://ritro.vercel.app with a Chrome extension (popup only, Alt+Shift+S to save the current tab) and a bookmarklet for other browsers. It is not a paid product and has no pricing plans.

What it does:
- Saves any link instantly; reads the page's title, description and preview image
- Adds 3 to 5 tags with Google Gemini in the background
- Search across titles, descriptions and tags; filter by tag or collection
- Daily digest email with up to five saves; "Surprise me" brings back a random save
- Export all data as JSON or delete the account from Settings
- No ads and no tracking cookies

What it does not do yet: semantic or vector search, notes or photo uploads, saving from Telegram or WhatsApp, Google or GitHub sign-in inside the extension, a Chrome Web Store listing.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ritrolabs/ritro): Next.js 16, Supabase (Postgres and auth), Prisma, Google Gemini, Upstash QStash and Redis, Resend, deployed on Vercel
